usage: icebath worktree [-h] {list,ls,audit,prune,restore} ...

Audit, reclaim and restore the .worktrees/ trees Icebath sessions accumulate. Idle trees with
uncommitted changes or unpushed commits are archived to refs/icebath/archive/<tree> before removal
(worktrees.archive_dirty); `restore` brings one back. In-use trees are never touched. See:
https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/git-worktrees

positional arguments:
  {list,ls,audit,prune,restore}
    list (ls, audit)    Classify every tree: age, size, verdict, reason (default action)
    prune               Remove safe trees and delete fully-merged local branches
    restore             Recreate an archived worktree (tracked, staged and untracked files)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
